headline: Sale or disposal of subsidiary
what_happened: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited has announced: Lemon Tree Hotels Limited has informed the Exchange about Sale or disposal of subsidiary. Pursuant to the execution of the Joint Venture Agreement (JVA), RJ Corp Limited shall acquire 49% stake by subscribing to fresh issuance of equity shares of Arum Hotels Private Limited (Arum). As contemplated under the JVA, Carnation Hotels Private Limited shall hold 51% of the equity share capital in Arum. Upon completion of the aforesaid transactions, Arum shall cease to be a step-down wholly owned subsidiary of the Company, and shall continue as a step-down subsidiary of the Company.
why_it_matters: The strategic acquisition broadens Lemon Tree Hotels Limited's operational portfolio and commercial capabilities, with financial accretion dependent on post-acquisition integration.
fundamental_impact: Positive — expands operational footprint and commercial capabilities.
key_financial_implication: Financial contribution will depend on transaction valuation and subsequent operational consolidation.
